name: How long does it take to build an ADU?
description: ADU construction typically takes 8-18 months, influenced by design, permitting, and site conditions, with permitting being a variable factor.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for ADU construction varies based on design complexity, permitting duration, and site conditions. On average, the entire process, from design to completion, can take 8 to 18 months. Permitting can be a significant variable; preparing all necessary documentation accurately and promptly can help expedite this phase of the project.
